name: Pin day high
note: Chartink translation, 4 Nov 2026 (Saurabh's 15-minute pin-bar scan, groups 1 and 3 folded into one): the last closed 15m bar's range is more than 3x its body, it has no lower wick (a green bar opening at its low, or a red bar closing at its low) and its high is the day's high: a long upper wick rejected at the high of the day. Chartink's [0] (forming bar) became off 1 (last closed bar), plus 09:45-15:00, price > 1000 and one alarm per stock per day, because the literal version rang 80-111 times a day. PARKED in scans/parked/ (the engine and API read only scans/*.json): move it up one folder to switch it on. Backtest 20 sessions (6 Oct-3 Nov 2026), stop = the bar's high, target 1:2, before costs. As Chartink has it (forming bar, all day, any price): 80 fires/day, target first 28 %, stop first 65 %, -0.12 R a trade, -33,222 INR at 1,000 INR max loss; 43 % of fires in the 09:15 hour because the forming bar's range is tiny and its high is the day high by definition. This closed-bar version: 6.8 fires/day, 24 % target, -0.23 R, -5,743 INR; no hour was positive. Parked: not an edge as a stop-at-wick trade.
